text:
alex: quick sync — customers keep seeing 'Degraded' in console while SDKs get opaque 5xx. they can't tell if it's routing fallback, quota, or model.

priya: we should expose a tiny client contract: `X-RW-FailMode: ok|degraded|throttled|unavailable` and `X-RW-Reason: <short-code>`. SDKs map to enums.

sam: add `Retry-After` for throttles. runtime will dual-emit old tags + new headers during rollout.

jordan: telemetry: emit `failmode`, `route_origin` (primary|fallback), `route_variant`. sample full headers for 1% of traffic. backfill 30d to avoid dashboard gaps.

lisa: SDK UX: surface a warn/log for `degraded`, provide `on_degrade` callback, and sanitize reason strings before showing to users.

alex: plan: feature-flag `ff/failmode-headers`; owners sam (runtime), lisa (SDK), priya (console), jordan (telemetry). i'll open RW-4220 RFC + tracker.

ops-bot: Ticket created: RW-4220 - "Client failmode headers and telemetry mapping" assigned: sam, lisa, priya, jordan.
